If your purchase doesn’t work out, your options are limited by our current policies:

Online orders: We do not offer exchanges for online purchases. You’ll need to wait for delivery, then follow our returns policy and steps as outlined on our returns page.
In-boutique full-priced items: These may be exchanged or returned for a full refund.
Non-returnable items: Certain products cannot be returned, exchanged, or refunded under any circumstances, including:
Hosiery
Lingerie, intimates and undergarments
Earrings and jewelry
Surfboards
Face masks
Gift cards
Any items marked “FINAL SALE - NO EXCHANGES - NO RETURNS”

So, if it doesn’t work out, you can generally return eligible items (following our returns process) or exchange/return full-priced boutique purchases, but final sale and restricted items cannot be sent back.
